title: {name} is in the papers
text: An off-field incident has made the back page. The board is watching how you handle it.

unanswered.text: You say nothing. The board wanted an answer.

choices.label: Stand him down for a week

effects.why: You stood him down over the papers story

choices.result: {name} is stood down for a week. The board approves.

choices.label: Back your player

effects.why: You backed him when he was in the papers

choices.result: You back {name}. The board is not impressed.
